name: Apache Ozone Open-Source Distributed Object Storage
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed distributed object storage software with S3-compatible interfaces, replication and erasure coding; self-hosted deployments have no software license fee or vendor-imposed free-plan expiration.
watch_out: Self-hosted software only, not free managed cloud object storage. Operators provide and pay for servers, disks, replication capacity, network/egress, backups, security and maintenance. S3-compatible client integrations and external services may have separate charges; Apache license notices apply.
